The '''Abafar system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Sprizen sector/Legends|Sprizen sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] which contained the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Abafar]].
